svg.title: Toolkit
svg.desc: Languages and tools: Java, Go, C++, Python, TypeScript, React, Node.js, Kotlin, Flutter, Spring, PostgreSQL, Redis, Kafka, gRPC, Docker, Git, Actions, SQLite. APIS & MESSAGING: REST · gRPC · Kafka, MQTT · SSE · webhooks. DATA & STORAGE: PostgreSQL · Redis · SQLite, FalkorDB · WAL · HNSW. AI SYSTEMS: RAG · MCP · embeddings, agents · model routing. RELIABILITY: idempotency · rate limits, crash recovery · TSan.
